title: Potierim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Potierim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Potierim is a ice-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Defense (C), Agility (B).

sections.title: Is the Potierim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (C), Agility (B). A dedicated ice pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
